failure_patterns.pattern: incomplete_domain_execution_and_date_handling: Agents blocked ready searches, invented missing hotel dates, or failed to use travel dates and route context already supplied.

rejected_edits.content: - On each turn, use the full conversation and cached result summaries to identify newly requested work and earlier explicit work that remains incomplete; leave unrelated or already-satisfied domains untouched. Reuse results only when their domain, subject, and prior criteria match. For additive changes, retrieve the most specific compatible result and apply only criteria absent from its summary. A broad category result does not satisfy a newly named specific-entity request; search for that entity in the matching domain. Assign each search or transformation result to a variable and save that exact value with `save_to_cache`, using the established canonical key for a reusable result and distinct suffixes only when multiple results in the same domain must coexist. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.
rejected_edits.target: - On each turn, consider the full conversation and cached result summaries. Reuse cached results only when their domain and subject match the request. If the user adds criteria, retrieve the closest compatible result, apply the matching filter, and save the updated result. Do not filter unrelated results; search for a requested entity or category that the cached results do not cover. Avoid retrieving unrelated results or repeating constraints in filters that were already applied. Save each newly generated search or transformation result under a unique cache key. Use “No planning needed” only when cached results already satisfy every current request.

rejected_edits.content: - Call `search_nearest` when the user explicitly requests results near, close to, or with access to another result type (for example, lodging near attractions); do not infer this request from an assistant’s unaccepted offer or an earlier suggestion when the latest user turn requests a separate refinement. Ensure compatible results for both types are available and apply relevant new filters before calling `search_nearest`; save its result. If a new criterion targets one component of a previously joined or nearest result, update and save that component’s compatible domain result rather than repeating the nearest operation with unfiltered inputs. Recompute the joined result only when the user requests an updated proximity result or that operation remains uncompleted. Set `groupBy` to the domain the user wants as the organizing base; when lodging is the planned base, group by hotel.
rejected_edits.target: - For recommendations near another result type, ensure compatible results for both types are available, then call `search_nearest` and save its result. Set `groupBy` to the domain the user wants as the organizing base; when lodging is the planned base, group by hotel.
